[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional information about Hearthstone:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. The game is a digital collectible card game in which players build decks of cards around a chosen hero to defeat their opponent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. As a new player, you'll start with a basic set of cards, but you can acquire more cards by playing, completing quests, and purchasing card packs with in-game currency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. There are different types of cards in the game, such as spells, minions, weapons, and hero cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Hearthstone is a turn-based game, which means that both players take turns playing one card at a time until one player's hero is defeated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The game has a ranking system that allows players to climb the ladder and earn rewards by winning matches against other players.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. There are different game modes in Hearthstone, including casual play, ranked play, and arena mode.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Hearthstone has a large and active community, so don't be afraid to seek out advice and tips from other players or online resources.
